# Multi-package: the root of a uv workspace. It holds the shared tool config and the dev
# tools; each package's own dependencies live in packages/<id>/pyproject.toml

# single-package pyproject.toml: [tool.ruff.lint] select/ignore, mccabe, pylint,
# per-file-ignores, [tool.ruff.format], [tool.size_limits], [tool.pytest.ini_options],
# [tool.typos.files], [tool.typos.default]. Only the sections below differ.
# references/ and probes/ are excluded from every tool here and in the copied sections (CR-08).
[project]
name = "minilab-workspace"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = [
    "mdata",
    "risk",
]

[tool.uv]
package = false                 # the root is not built; it installs every member

[tool.uv.workspace]
members = ["packages/*"]

[tool.uv.sources]
mdata = { workspace = true }
risk = { workspace = true }

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "ruff",
    "mypy",
    "pyright",
    "pytest",
    "pytest-cov",
    "hypothesis",
    "deptry",
    "vulture",
    "pylint",
    "typos",
    "import-linter",
    "pip-audit",

]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py311"
src = ["packages/mdata/src", "packages/risk/src", "tests"]
output-prefer-rule-codes = true # preview mode prints rule names; noqa and CONSTRAINTS.md use codes
extend-exclude = ["scripts/vulture_whitelist.py", "references", "probes"]
force-exclude = true            # excluded even when a path is passed explicitly (check.sh fast)

[tool.ruff.lint.isort]
known-first-party = ["mdata", "risk"]

[tool.mypy]
python_version = "3.11"
files = ["packages/mdata/src", "packages/risk/src"]
exclude = ["^references/", "^probes/"]
strict = true
show_error_codes = true
pretty = true

[tool.pyright]
include = ["packages/mdata/src", "packages/risk/src"]
pythonVersion = "3.11"
typeCheckingMode = "standard"
reportUnnecessaryTypeIgnoreComment = true
enableTypeIgnoreComments = false

[tool.coverage.run]
source_pkgs = ["mdata", "risk"]
omit = ["references/*", "probes/*"]
branch = true

[tool.coverage.report]
skip_covered = true
show_missing = true
exclude_also = ["if TYPE_CHECKING:", "raise NotImplementedError"]
fail_under = 0

# contracts inside a package go here too.
[tool.importlinter]
root_packages = ["mdata", "risk"]

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "Layers: risk > mdata"
type = "layers"
layers = ["risk", "mdata"]

[tool.vulture]
paths = ["packages/mdata/src", "packages/risk/src", "scripts/vulture_whitelist.py"]
exclude = ["references/", "probes/"]
min_confidence = 60

[tool.ruff.lint]
preview = true                  # needed for PLR0914 / PLR1702 / PLR0904 below
